from qiskit.optimization.initial_guesses import UniformSampling
from qiskit.utils import algorithm_globals

    G.add_weighted_edges_from(data["graph_edges"])

    p = 1
    q = 2
    num_iterations = 10

    # Define the cost function and objective for QAOA
    def cost_function(x):
        return sum([G[u][v] * x[u] * (1 - x[v]) for u, v in G.edges if x[u] != x[v]] + [0 if x[u] == x[v] for u, v in G.edges if x[u] == x[v]])

    def qaoa_objective(beta, gamma):
        qc = QuantumCircuit(num_qubits, num_qubits)
        qc.h(range(num_qubits))
        for i in range(num_qubits):
            qc.cx(i, i + 1)
        for beta_i, gamma_i in zip(beta, gamma):
            for i in range(num_qubits):
                qc.ry(2 * np.pi * beta_i, i)
                qc.cz(i, (i + 1) % num_qubits)
                qc.ry(-2 * np.pi * gamma_i, i)
        qc.measure_all()
        return QAOA(cost_function, qc, p, q, max_iter=num_iterations)

    # Initialize the optimizer and run QAOA
    optimizer = dimod.qaoa.QAOAGROSSWITCH(max_iters=num_iterations)
    initial_guess = UniformSampling(num_qubits)

    # Calculate the approximation ratio (assuming an ideal QAOA solution)

    approximation_ratio = cut_value / min_cut

        "circuit_depth": circuit_depth,
        "two_qubit_gate_count": two_qubit_gate_count,
